title: What we read for Less processed
standfirst: The names this plan looks for on a label, and where the list stops.

spans.text: When you turn this plan on, we read the ingredient list on a label and look for a set of names. This is that set, in full.
We show it because a plan that marks a food off-plan should be able to say which word did it.

This is the list we read, not a ruling on what belongs in the plan. Bodies that certify foods, and clinicians who advise on them, do not all draw the line in the same place, and a label can name an ingredient in a form no list holds.
